from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/growbox-output-supervisor-physical-h-v1.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''            self.identity_ok = True
            self.output_mode_ok = outputs == "real-bounded"
            self.rf_ready = rf_ready == "1"
            if not self.output_mode_ok or not self.rf_ready:
                raise HFailure(f"real output transport not ready outputs={outputs!r} rf_ready={rf_ready!r}")
            return
'''
new = '''            self.identity_ok = True
            self.output_mode_ok = outputs == "real-bounded"
            self.rf_ready = rf_ready == "1"
            return
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('startup transport patch anchor missing')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
s = s.replace('while time.monotonic() < identity_deadline and not observer.identity_ok:', 'while time.monotonic() < identity_deadline and not (observer.identity_ok and observer.output_mode_ok and observer.rf_ready):', 1)
old = '''        if not observer.identity_ok:
            raise HFailure("could not verify exact firmware identity")
        session = discover_session(observer)
        wait_until_ready(observer)
        run_h(observer, session)
'''
new = '''        if not (observer.identity_ok and observer.output_mode_ok and observer.rf_ready):
            raise HFailure("could not verify exact firmware identity and real output transport readiness")
        wait_until_ready(observer)
        session = discover_session(observer)
        run_h(observer, session)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('startup ordering patch anchor missing')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
